text: NAXOS, or NAXIA, a considerable town, and capital of the lake of Naoxe, opposite the lake of Peru, with a cudal and two ambishaby’s seen, the one check out the other Latin. The greater part of the inhabitants are Greek, Lilly, 25.13. E., Lae 37.6.N.

parsed.faithful: NAXOS, or NAXIA, a considerable town, and capital of the Isle of Naxos, opposite the Isle of Paros, with a castle and two archbishops' sees, the one Greek and the other Latin. The greater part of the inhabitants are Greeks. Long. 25. 51. E. Lat. 37. 8. N.
